description:
7th October 2026 |
RISAO Aerocity, Delhi
A productive and insightful visit to RISAO Aerocity, Delhi, by Rtn PP Hemendra Shah where he had the opportunity to *meet and interact with Rajesh Anand, Shakuntala, Ashwini Sharma, Roy John, Summit William, Ankita Shruti, Moumita Deb and other members of the team.
The meeting provided an excellent platform to discuss various issues and opportunities relating to CSR initiatives and Rotary Global Grants, and to explore possibilities for greater collaboration and impactful projects in the future.
It was wonderful to exchange ideas, share experiences and understand how we can collectively strengthen our efforts towards creating sustainable and meaningful community impact.
Attended by Rtn PP Hemendra Shah
